title: Race the Sun — South Downs (Hike, Bike, Canoe)
description: Action Medical Research multisport team challenge on the South Downs: ~33 mile cycle, ~10 mile coastal hike (Seven Sisters), ~2 mile canoe on the River Cuckmere. Completed as a team, 'Hips, Knees and Toes'. Stage splits — 1: 3:43:10 (46th, +1:16:46) · 2: 3:33:27 (37th, +1:14:09) · 3: 42:19 (50th, +42:17) · 4: 1:08:40 (34th, +39:36). Overall +3:03:17 behind the leaders.
